description: Append a reading to the local append-only journal and return its id. Note: passing `journal` to the compute tool is the PREFERRED path — it captures the engine-derived lean/confidence/score itself so the track record can't drift. Use this only to log a reading computed elsewhere.

expectedResolutionAt.description: When this reading is expected resolvable (the "ask me later" date, ISO-8601).

kind.description: The chart kind this reading used.

profile.description: Profile slug to log against (default: the active one).

verdictText.description: The plain-language verdict given at log time.

name: memory_log
title: Log a reading to the journal
